limits: Identical quick ranking across each pair is the recorded result, not a scoring failure. The brief never sees strcpy/recv; the patch lives in libcgc-facing helpers named by DWARF.
Following handoff.next_argv decompiled the planted site on Palindrome only (1/9). CNMP showed cgc_insert_joke as a callee. The other seven missed under a 2-hop budget.
The earlier source-guided decompile of cgc_list_unread_messages is not a loop result.
verify was not forced: there is no relevant external import sink.
Official type 1 POVs did not register a core under qemu-user linux/amd64 without gdb. POLLs passed on both variants. Patched POVs correctly did not core.
Raw target bytes, POLL/POV transcripts, and the builder image stay out of git.
